name: UK project manager returning after caregiving

context.employment_state: Returning after a caregiving career break
constraints: Hybrid work acceptable if commute is feasible
Wants to rebuild confidence without being treated as a beginner
context.company_awareness: No firm shortlist; familiar past employers and returner programmes are starting points

trigger: A more dependable care arrangement creates time to return to paid work, but a search for project management roles mostly presents full-time schedules.

searches_run.query: part time project manager jobs UK school hours hybrid
searches_run.observation: Results included general boards, charity roles and a concrete Historic England 0.7 FTE hybrid vacancy. Direct inspection confirmed that example had already closed and did not establish school-hours scheduling.

searches_run.query: project manager return to work career break part time returnship UK
searches_run.observation: Results included official returner guidance, a project-management professional-body guide and employer returnship pages. These describe routes and support, not a verified currently open school-hours role.

sources.title: Part Time Project Manager - Creative Content Exchange — Historic England
sources.supports: Directly inspected employer ATS page states 0.7 FTE, hybrid locations, a fixed term and pro-rata salary. It explicitly says applications closed 23 August 2026; no guaranteed school-hours pattern was shown.

sources.title: Part-time Hybrid Project Manager Jobs — Reed
sources.supports: Retrieved job-board page targets this combined role/work-pattern query and offers alerts. Counts are not treated as verified current supply.

sources.title: Returner toolkit: helping you back to work — GOV.UK
sources.supports: Retrieved official guidance distinguishes several return routes and working patterns. Used only to observe available guidance, not legal entitlements or individual programme eligibility.

sources.title: Returning to work — National Highways
sources.supports: Retrieved employer snippet advertises a six-month returnship for people with a career break. Direct access failed with 502; no current intake or role availability verified.

best_entry_page.primary_query: part time project manager jobs returners UK
best_entry_page.promise: Explore employers advertising reduced-hours project roles or returner pathways, and compare the stated schedule, location and application status.
best_entry_page.cta: Check suitable openings first, then save a part-time project-management search.
proof_needed: Use actually open examples; separate a programme information page from an open intake.
Show hours, days, commute location and hybrid expectations where stated.
Distinguish school-hours, term-time, part-time and compressed full-time schedules.
Respect prior experience; career breaks do not imply junior level.
Verify coverage beyond technology companies, including public and charitable employers.
Publish a new indexable guide; filtered search currently remains noindex.

conversion_objections: Will you show actual openings or more confidence-building advice?
Does part-time fit school collection times?
Will a break exclude me despite my previous experience?
Will the system keep showing closed returner programmes?
Can I start free before deciding whether description checks help?

avoid_targeting.query: school hours project manager guaranteed flexible
avoid_targeting.reason: General flexibility and reduced FTE do not establish daily start/end times.

avoid_targeting.query: track all applications from every job site
avoid_targeting.reason: The demonstrated tracker saves indexed postings; arbitrary external imports are not established.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I need to see that there are project roles whose hours could work, before I need another article telling me to feel confident. Let me inspect the schedule and closing date, then keep me informed when similar jobs appear.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic gender-neutral returner, not an interview. Two queries and one successful source inspection plus one failed employer open. Exact location, break length and availability are not supplied, so commute fit and returnship eligibility remain unknown. No search volumes, hiring outcomes or programme availability inferred.

search_journey.fit_reason: Employment type and role filters fit.
